ModMetaData.name: Command Hotkeys
ModMetaData.author: zirize
ModMetaData.description:
Bind a key to any command button (gizmo) or Architect item, and open each Architect category with its own key, even while the Architect menu is closed.
- Hover over a command button, or select an Architect item, and press the "assign hotkey" key (default: \). Pick "Set key" and press the key you want. - Command keys work while that button is shown for the current selection; the key letter appears on the button. - Architect item keys select the item from anywhere on the map. - Architect category keys: Options > Keyboard > "Command hotkeys: Architect". - Map toggle keys for the icons at the bottom right (zones, roof / fertility / terrain / temperature / pollution / vacuum overlays, colonist bar, learning helper, auto home area, auto rebuild, categorized resource readout): Options > Keyboard > "Command hotkeys: map toggles". - Keys may be chords: hold Ctrl/Shift/Alt (left and right told apart) while pressing the key in the assign dialog. Options > Keyboard shows them and sets them the same way. - Requires Harmony (only the keyboard settings screen is patched, to show and set chords). Built for RimWorld 1.7 (.NET 10).
An independent spiritual successor to Hotkeys 1.6 (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3536306259) and Architect Hotkeys Anywhere (https://github.com/zirize/RimWorld-ArchitectHotkeysAnywhere); it contains no code from the Hotkeys mod.
